remarks: Absolutely stunning North Stamford oasis peacefully situated overlooking a 15-acre freshwater lake fed by the Mianus River, private access to which is granted to only 6 homes. Complete remodel - House was gutted down to the studs and remodeled in 2006/2007. Upon entry, the wide-open floor plan, walls of glass with breath-taking views of the lake, incredible natural light, and 14ft+ vaulted ceilings will astound you. This immaculate space is ideal for both living & entertaining. The house features luxury high-end features throughout. The Kitchen includes an eat-in area and has an oversized custom island, waterfall slab Lagos Azul Stone counters, imported custom Italian Boffi cabinets, dual Viking wall ovens, Two Miele dishwashers, skylights, exposed beams, access points to side & back decks. A large combo "dirty kitchen" and laundry room is adjacent. A double-sided gas fireplace, new Trex composite deck and custom glass walls connects the kitchen to the formal living room and dining room. The Primary suite is jaw-dropping with stunning views of the lake from the bedroom, bathroom and private deck. It features a second Lagos Azul wall with double sided gas fireplace to the primary bathroom. Custom Italian Boffi cabinets, dual sinks, soaking tub and unique dual "Pipe Showers" all with Dorn Bracht fixtures and radiant heated floors. The walk-in dressing room with custom cabinets, stone topped center island and chandelier is enormous and fit for any fashionista.
